channel.title: Escape to the Country
channel.desc: It's showtime as Ginny Buckley helps a couple who work in the theatre to swap London's hustle and bustle for West Yorkshire's hills and heather, where they hope to find a home with real star appeal. From grand views to charming nooks, every property brings a touch of rural drama. Along the way, Ginny meets another family who made their own leap of faith, leaving city life behind to start afresh on a 30-acre farm, proving that life in the country can be the best act yet.
